describe: make a line chart that shows how something changes over time
guide: Sort by the time column and draw axes.plot of the number against it. If several groups share the same times, draw one line per group with a legend. Label both axes and save into the chart folder.
Never state a finding the code has not computed: write code that prints the result, run it, then quote what it printed.
report: I drew $what -- it is saved as $chart.
teach: Sorting by time first matters: a line joins the points in order, so unsorted rows zig-zag.
